ns2:course.label: Psychology of Race & Ethnicity
ns2:course.description: Exploration of the theoretical, empirical, and experiential writings concerning the issues of race and ethnicity as they relate to human behavior from the perspective of the individual in various social contexts. Same as AFRO 312. Prerequisite: PSYC 100.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman, Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
